name: rich-text
title: Rich Text
description: An inline text primitive with a rich gradient surface and configurable color treatment.

export interface RichTextProps extends React.HTMLAttributes { children: React.ReactNode; color?: RichTextColor; } const colorMap: Record = { default: "from-zinc-900 to-zinc-600 dark:from-zinc-100 dark:to-zinc-400", emerald: "from-emerald-500 to-emerald-700 dark:from-emerald-300 dark:to-emerald-500", blue: "from-blue-500 to-blue-700 dark:from-blue-300 dark:to-blue-500", purple: "from-purple-500 to-purple-700 dark:from-purple-300 dark:to-purple-500", pink: "from-pink-500 to-pink-700 dark:from-pink-300 dark:to-pink-500", red: "from-red-500 to-red-700 dark:from-red-300 dark:to-red-500", orange: "from-orange-500 to-orange-700 dark:from-orange-300 dark:to-orange-500", yellow: "from-yellow-500 to-yellow-700 dark:from-yellow-300 dark:to-yellow-500", green: "from-green-500 to-green-700 dark:from-green-300 dark:to-green-500", teal: "from-teal-500 to-teal-700 dark:from-teal-300 dark:to-teal-500", cyan: "from-cyan-500 to-cyan-700 dark:from-cyan-300 dark:to-cyan-500", indigo: "from-indigo-500 to-indigo-700 dark:from-indigo-300 dark:to-indigo-500", violet: "from-violet-500 to-violet-700 dark:from-violet-300 dark:to-violet-500", rose: "from-rose-500 to-rose-700 dark:from-rose-300 dark:to-rose-500", amber: "from-amber-500 to-amber-700 dark:from-amber-300 dark:to-amber-500", lime: "from-lime-500 to-lime-700 dark:from-lime-300 dark:to-lime-500", sky: "from-sky-500 to-sky-700 dark:from-sky-300 dark:to-sky-500", slate: "from-slate-500 to-slate-700 dark:from-slate-300 dark:to-slate-500", gray: "from-gray-500 to-gray-700 dark:from-gray-300 dark:to-gray-500", zinc: "from-zinc-500 to-zinc-700 dark:from-zinc-300 dark:to-zinc-500", neutral: "from-neutral-500 to-neutral-700 dark:from-neutral-300 dark:to-neutral-500", stone: "from-stone-500 to-stone-700 dark:from-stone-300 dark:to-stone-500", fuchsia: "from-fuchsia-500 to-fuchsia-700 dark:from-fuchsia-300 dark:to-fuchsia-500", }; const textShadowMap: Record = { default: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_rgb(255,255,255)] dark:[text-shadow:0_1px_0_rgb(0,0,0)]", emerald: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-emerald-800)]", blue: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-blue-800)]", purple: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-purple-800)]", pink: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-pink-800)]", red: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-red-800)]", orange: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-orange-800)]", yellow: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-yellow-800)]", green: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-green-800)]", teal: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-teal-800)]", cyan: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-cyan-800)]", indigo: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-indigo-800)]", violet: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-violet-800)]", rose: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-rose-800)]", amber: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-amber-800)]", lime: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-lime-800)]", sky: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-sky-800)]", slate: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-slate-800)]", gray: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-gray-800)]", zinc: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-zinc-800)]", neutral: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-neutral-800)]", stone: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-stone-800)]", fuchsia: "[text-shadow:0_1px_0_var(--color-fuchsia-800)]", }; function RichText({ children, color = "default", className, ...props }: RichTextProps) { return ( {children} ); } RichText.displayName = "RichText"; export { RichText };
